title: Min stack
statement: Design a stack class MinStack with push(x), pop(), top() and get_min(), all in O(1). Methods are only called when valid.
hints: What would you need to know about the minimum after a pop?
Store, alongside each element, the minimum of the stack up to and including it.

solution.explanation: Keep a second stack of running minima: when pushing x, push min(x, current min). Pop both together. The invariant: mins[i] is the minimum of stack[0..i], so after any pop the new top of mins is the correct minimum.
